classification.difficultyReason: Use the specified rectangle corners to link successive complementary-angle calculations in overlapping figures.

content.prompt: Determine the size of the missing angles using complementary angles. All outlined quadrilaterals in this question are rectangles.

spec.description: Complete upright red square and tilted black square sharing their lower-right dotted vertex; three consecutive labelled sectors.
spec.mathematics: At the common vertex the incident directions are 180, 160, 90 and 70 degrees. The intended rectangular corners give 20+a=90 and a+b=90. Rectangularity is depicted but unstated.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 20°, a° and b° appear; teacher answers are excluded.

answer.worked:
Angles in a right angle add to $90^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}a+20&=90\\a&=70\\a+b&=90\\70+b&=90\\b&=20\end{align*}$$
$a=70^\circ,\ b=20^\circ$.

spec.description: Black upright square and red tilted rectangle share their upper-left dotted vertex.
spec.mathematics: Incident directions 25, 0, -65 and -90 degrees place d, 65 and c in consecutive sectors. Intended right corners give c+65=90 and d+65=90.

answer.worked:
Angles in a right angle add to $90^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}c+65&=90\\c&=25\\d+65&=90\\d&=25\end{align*}$$
$c=25^\circ,\ d=25^\circ$.

spec.description: Solid black tilted rectangle and dashed red rectangle share their rightmost dotted vertex.
spec.mathematics: Incident directions 105, 138, 195 and 228 degrees give consecutive f, 57 and e sectors. Both intended corners are right angles.

answer.worked:
Angles in a right angle add to $90^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}e+57&=90\\e&=33\\f+57&=90\\f&=33\end{align*}$$
$e=33^\circ,\ f=33^\circ$.

spec.description: Four finite arms with a common dotted vertex, an oblique red right-angle marker, and the inventory-approved additional black right-angle marker.
spec.mathematics: Directions 180, 140, 90 and 50 degrees. Both perpendicular pairs are explicitly marked in the reconstruction.

answer.worked:
Angles in a right angle add to $90^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}a+40&=90\\a&=50\\a+b&=90\\50+b&=90\\b&=40\end{align*}$$
$a=50^\circ,\ b=40^\circ$.

spec.description: Four finite arms with a common dotted vertex, an oblique red right-angle marker and the approved additional black marker.
spec.mathematics: Directions 145, 90, 55 and 0 degrees place c, d and 55 in consecutive sectors.

answer.worked:
Angles in a right angle add to $90^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}d+55&=90\\d&=35\\c+d&=90\\c+35&=90\\c&=55\end{align*}$$
$c=55^\circ,\ d=35^\circ$.

spec.description: Four finite arms with a common dotted vertex; red oblique right-angle marker retained and approved black marker added.
spec.mathematics: Directions 117, 180, 207 and 270 degrees give sectors e, 27 and f.

answer.worked:
Angles in a right angle add to $90^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}e+27&=90\\e&=63\\f+27&=90\\f&=63\end{align*}$$
$e=63^\circ,\ f=63^\circ$.

spec.description: Dashed black upright square, solid red rectangle above-left and dotted red square below-right share a vertex. Every outline remains visible.
spec.mathematics: Incident directions 160, 90, 70, 40, 0 and -50 degrees preserve the 70 and 30 degree sectors and the unknown sector below the black horizontal side.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 70°, 30° and a° appear; auxiliary solution variables are absent.

answer.worked:
Let $u$ be the angle between the upward black side and the steep upper-right solid red side, and $v$ the angle between the upper-right dotted red side and the rightward black side. Angles in each right angle add to $90^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}u+70&=90\\u&=20\\20+30+v&=90\\50+v&=90\\v&=40\\a+40&=90\\a&=50\end{align*}$$
$a=50^\circ$.

spec.description: Solid black upright square above-left, dashed red square above-right and dotted red square below-left share a vertex.
spec.mathematics: Incident directions 30, 90, 120, 160, 180 and 250 degrees retain the 60 and 40 degree sectors and b below the leftward black side.

answer.worked:
Let $u$ be the angle between the upward black side and the upper-left dashed red side, and $v$ the angle between the leftward black side and the upper-left dotted red side. Angles in each right angle add to $90^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}u+60&=90\\u&=30\\v+40+30&=90\\v+70&=90\\v&=20\\b+20&=90\\b&=70\end{align*}$$
$b=70^\circ$.

spec.description: Black upright square below-left, dotted red square above-left and dashed red rectangle below-right share the black square's top-right vertex.
spec.mathematics: Incident directions 115, 180, 205, 245, 270 and 335 degrees retain c, 40 and 65 in their source sectors.

answer.worked:
Let $u$ be the angle between the downward black side and the lower-left dashed red side, and $v$ the angle between the leftward black side and the shallow lower-left dotted red side. Angles in each right angle add to $90^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}u+65&=90\\u&=25\\v+40+25&=90\\v+65&=90\\v&=25\\c+25&=90\\c&=65\end{align*}$$
$c=65^\circ$.

spec.description: Three complete overlapping rectangles share an upper vertex: solid black tilted below-right, dashed red tilted below-left and dotted red upright below-right.
spec.mathematics: Incident directions 200, 240, 270, 290, 330 and 360 degrees retain the 40 degree sector, unknown a between downward dotted and steep lower-right dashed sides, and 30 degrees below the horizontal dotted side.

answer.worked:
Let $u$ be the angle between the downward dotted red side and the lower-right black side, and $v$ the angle between the lower-left black side and the downward dotted red side. Angles in each right angle add to $90^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}u+30&=90\\u&=60\\v+60&=90\\v&=30\\40+30+a&=90\\70+a&=90\\a&=20\end{align*}$$
$a=20^\circ$.

spec.description: Dashed black upright rectangle, solid red diamond-shaped square and dotted red tilted square share a lower-left vertex.
spec.mathematics: Incident directions 135, 90, 75, 45, 0 and -15 degrees place 45, b and 15 in the source sectors. The intended right corners give b=30 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: The diagram retains b°. Printed teacher evidence a=30 is recorded in an unresolved finding; no answer is shown here.

answer.worked:
Let $u$ be the angle between the upward black side and the upper-right solid red side, and $v$ the angle between that solid red side and the rightward black side. Angles in each right angle add to $90^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}45+u&=90\\u&=45\\45+v&=90\\v&=45\\b+45+15&=90\\b+60&=90\\b&=30\end{align*}$$
$b=30^\circ$.

spec.description: Dashed black upright square, solid red tilted rectangle and dotted red tilted rectangle share a lower-left vertex; every outline remains visible.
spec.mathematics: Incident directions 111, 90, 54, 21, 0 and -36 degrees retain the source 21 and 36 degree sectors and b between the upper-right red sides.

answer.worked:
Let $u$ be the angle between the upward black side and the shallow upper-right solid red side, and $v$ the angle between that solid red side and the rightward black side. Angles in each right angle add to $90^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}21+u&=90\\u&=69\\69+v&=90\\v&=21\\b+21+36&=90\\b+57&=90\\b&=33\end{align*}$$
$b=33^\circ$.
